'''Obsidian''' is a [[Minerals#Geode Minerals|mineral]] that can be found in the [[Magma Geode]] and the [[Omni Geode]]. If married to [[Sebastian]], he will occasionally gift it to you.

==Tailoring==
Obsidian is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Studded Vest]].  [[File:Shirt169.png|24px]]
